_README: Rate card used to price local token usage. EDIT THIS FILE to correct a rate;
no pipeline logic reads a hard-coded price. Re-run scripts/build_daily_burn.py
after editing and the whole ledger reprices (cost is derived, never frozen).
BASIS: these are public API list prices. The usage they are applied to was
almost certainly incurred on flat-rate subscriptions (Claude Max, ChatGPT),
NOT on metered API billing. The resulting dollar figure is therefore a
COUNTERFACTUAL -- what this usage would have cost at API list prices -- and
not money that was actually spent. See ESTIMATES.md.
A model with no entry here is priced as UNKNOWN, never as zero: its tokens
are counted in cost_usd.unpriced_tokens, its per-model cost_usd is null, and
build_daily_burn.py prints a warning naming the model and the affected days.

token_types.input: Uncached input tokens, billed at the model's base input rate.
token_types.cache_write_5m: Tokens written to a 5-minute ephemeral prompt cache (Anthropic: 1.25x base input).
token_types.cache_write_1h: Tokens written to a 1-hour ephemeral prompt cache (Anthropic: 2x base input).
token_types.cache_read: Tokens served from prompt cache (Anthropic: 0.1x base input; OpenAI publishes its own cached-input rate).
token_types.output: Output tokens. Includes OpenAI reasoning tokens, which bill at the output rate.

claude-sonnet-5.notes: The launch price is now permanent; the previously announced September increase was cancelled.

gpt-5.5.notes: Standard short-context benchmark; no cache-write dimension in this legacy model rate.

gpt-5.6-sol.notes: Standard processing, short-context benchmark. Logs do not preserve per-request context tier. Published cache-write pricing is recorded separately: logs currently report zero writes and do not specify an Anthropic-style TTL. Nonzero Codex writes are treated as unattributed until their split can be verified. Current promotional rate is available at least through 2026-11-21; review at expiry.

<synthetic>.source: Not a model. Claude Code writes assistant entries with model "<synthetic>" for locally-generated turns (e.g. an API error surfaced as a message). Every such entry in the local logs carries zero tokens in all four usage fields, so the zero rate is exact, not an assumption.

benchmark: Current standard processing and short-context public rates applied to all recorded history; not a reconstruction of historical invoices. Context-tier, fast-mode, regional and tool charges are excluded.
